scope: Read-only API/source review for the approved original-patch feasibility census. No runtime/API import, WASM instantiation, simplification, Blender launch, build or install occurred. This is not candidate launch approval.
decisive_conclusion: An installed enforceable route exists conditionally: experimental simplifyWithAttributes supplies actual native vertex locks. Bare vertex locks preserve locked source vertices, not their complete incident stars. A conservative closed guard around every protected face/interface/junction can freeze the required connectivity, but the original <=6000-face patch must retain enough certified eligible interior after that guard. Zero/insufficient eligible interior requires BLOCKED before any candidate.

Do not use attribute_stride0: the JS modulo assertion rejects it. Freeze actual settings separately after feasibility.
actual_API.not_supplied: No face-lock mask, arbitrary eligible-edge predicate or user collapse callback is exposed. Attribute weighting is not a colour-fidelity acceptance guarantee. No experimental attribute solve or fitted attributes are needed merely to use locks.

installed_fixture_evidence.name: meshopt_simplifier.test.js:simplifyLockFlags
installed_fixture_evidence.observation: Its declared expected output preserves the original all-locked triangles but replaces faces involving unlocked vertex4 by a new triangle joining locked vertices2,5,3. Therefore a locked vertex can receive an unlocked collapse and its star can change. The fixture was read, not executed.

native_source_context.interpretation: Upstream0.22 propagates locks across identical-position wedges and forbids outgoing locked collapses; incoming collapses remain possible. This is source context, not a traced collapse history or independent binary equivalence proof.

sufficient_conservative_protection_certi: Extract the original junction's complete original incident faces plus the declared surrounding face rings, keeping original face/vertex IDs. Stop above6000 original triangles; do not truncate a star or silently delete outside context.

Let S contain every vertex of every face whose connectivity must remain immutable, including complete original junction stars, sheet interfaces, orientation conflicts and crop/boundary rings. Record the exact protected oriented face multiset and original junction incidences.

Within the actual input position buffer, close S under the native identical-F32-position equivalence. Lock S and every original edge neighbour of those protected position classes; propagate the lock mask across identical-position classes as well. Include all source stars needed to prove this closure.

Reason: protected vertices cannot be removed, and every possible adjacent source for an incoming collapse is also locked. Every original face incident to protected S therefore keeps its source-ID triple; no new face can arrive at S through an unlocked neighbour. This is a conservative graph argument whose prerequisites must be independently checked in the actual extracted input.

Mark every interface between separately identified sheets as protected; do not infer sheet identity merely from vertex-connected component labels. Any coincident class spanning sheets must be protected. Exclude crop crossings, nonmanifold edges, inconsistent incidence-two orientation and link-condition failures from eligible interior.

Only remaining certified within-sheet interior may be considered mutable. LockBorder can add border protection, but cannot replace this explicit guard. Disable Prune, weld, reconstruction, compaction/reordering algorithms and automatic fallback; exact source-ID compaction alone remains permissible.
limits_and_admission: The method still does not guarantee no new duplicate or nonmanifold edge inside unprotected mutable interior, a chosen reduction count, or geometry/colour fidelity. Independent exact acceptance checks remain mandatory on the single result.

Count strict eligible interior and protected-face floor before deciding whether approximately20percent eligible-interior reduction is plausible. Positive edge count is necessary, not proof the native method reaches the target/error. Do not count immutable protected faces in the meaningful-reduction denominator.

Keep retained source positions and native colours exact; newly connected face interiors still need genuine spatial-material and paired/unpaired original-surface analysis, with frozen colour/scalar/silhouette/depth gates. No colour fitting or repair follows a failure.

Only after independent feasibility and implementation review may the one approved disposable original-patch candidate run under6GiB process+Job/180seconds/live12GiB RAM/2GiB disk. No full mesh reduction, original/rejected asset modification or second candidate is admitted here.

Blender_Collapse_alternative.finding: A valid vertex group with positive group factor supplies weights; exact zero on either endpoint excludes an edge. Collapse also rejects endpoint stars touching nonmanifold edges. Ordinary boundaries are not immutable by default.
Blender_Collapse_alternative.limitation: Free coordinates and CustomData can change, making exact source/colour correspondence less direct than index-only Meshopt. This is a genuine installed alternative, not a selected fallback or candidate authorization.
